keyFindings.description: main 2d3a725f added 0142_item_blocks, 0143_comments_item_blocks_trigger, 0144_messages_item_blocks_trigger and 0145-0147 since the merge base de546ed2. This branch's 0142-0144 share those versions, and pgmigrate.Load refuses shared versions (pgmigrate/set.go:138), so the merge group and every server start on the merged tree fail. GitHub shows MERGEABLE only because the file names differ. Merge main forward (no rebase), renumber to 0148-0150 and every doc, fragment and comment naming them; keep leasePoolSize/permanentListeners/dispatchConnectionsPerPod at main's plus this change's own; check #2480's single pmdoc.Update write in ReplaceText against the close freeze and lock order.

A departing reader's removal can be relayed at clock 0: watchRoomAwareness's observer runs after ygo releases the awareness lock; touched calls aw.EncodeUpdate(left) (:668) after dropping r.mu, while received() (:595-601, the awareness lane) and any other removal's observer purge tombstones with a 1 ns grace (awarenessTombstoneAge :109). EncodeUpdate of a purged client writes clock 0 null (ygo awareness.go:477-480); the other process holds clock >= 1 and drops it (awareness.go:579-581), so the cursor stays there for up to 30 s, against 'a reader who leaves on one process leaves on the other'. Keep the removal's clock in the relay or a grace longer than observer-to-encode; test with a purge between ApplyUpdate and the relay's observer.
removeLocalAwareness enqueues its removal and then applies it, whose observer records the same removal again (:761-762, :295-306); delete the enqueue there and inline enqueue into answer.
decideAppend kept apart for a batch caller that no longer exists (:142-144, :186-196); fold it into gateAppend.
978 -> 1,221 lines; move the stored-head following code (flushOtherRooms, followStoredHead, readStoredHead, roomHoldsHead, roomHeld, lostAtStoredHead) into its own file.

Shared processPair fixture sits in a 2,087-line test file (:39-230); move it to process_pair_test.go; newQueueProcesses (conditional_edit_queue_test.go:21-28) still wraps it (round-2 item 10 not done).

Four copies of one awareness-update encoder (awareness_limit_test.go:165, awareness_flood_bound_test.go:27, awareness_relay_test.go:326,339) and trackedAwarenessClients repeating heldAwarenessClients.
Two near-identical 200-socket tests (many_sockets and room_bound, same project key MNY) and the flood setup pasted four times; merge and extract dial/announce helpers.

Repeats awareness_limit_socket_test.go:29-67; detects the deadline by error text 'i/o timeout' (:39) where errors.Is(os.ErrDeadlineExceeded) is used elsewhere; cites 'Census entry 4'. One table-driven test with errors.Is.
Test text names a room bound of 256 (:17-18; awareness_room_bound_multiprocess_test.go:20) and a 2,048-client frame (awareness_relay_test.go:450, frame is 32,000).
Duplicated discard branch (:208-216, :275-287); framePayloadLength repeats keepalive.go frameBegins' length decode, and the frame primitives live in keepalive.go.
issueOpenChanged, query and answer are pass-through fields never overridden (:152-158, :163-170).

'A browser tab announces one client' (awareness_limit.go:17-18, :41-46; README.md:681 'one more than a browser tab ever announces'; cursors fragment; census 4) is false: the provider's awarenessUpdateHandler echoes every changed client, the tab's own first. Describe the real behaviour; census 4's consumer search should reach awarenessUpdateHandler.

'at most two of a document's conditional edits hold a database connection at once' (README.md:733-736 and the rebuild/resumption/queue fragment) is false: a release's count write (conditional_edit_queue.go:219-233), a waiting admission and the new turn's write transaction can hold three.

Census 4: second search finds four unlisted files (cmd/dispatch awareness_many_sockets, awareness_room_bound, awareness_simultaneous multiprocess tests; docs/awareness_limit_upgrade_test.go); awareness_relay_test.go described as 'one or a few clients per socket' (it applies 32,000); Rollout line omits entry 4. Stale lines: Size, Proven by head ff5c1919, Fast-follow 256/2 MB (now 4,000/31 MB).
Earlier-build exception missing (:15-16, and PR body Notes bullet 1): a document the close or reopen writes moves its head, so the earlier build's room closes and reconnects with the new scope.

verified: Round-2 item 2: patchIssue re-stamps closed_at = clock_timestamp() before commit (api/issue_patch.go:528-546); TestAKeystrokeWaitingOnASlowClosesDocumentLockIsStored fails before the fix and passes after.
Round-2 item 3: closeRoomOnReplacedHistory (service.go:2679, websocket.go:186); TestARoomIsReloadedOnceAKeystrokeLandsOnAHistoryACompactionFolded fails before (timeout) and passes after.
Round-2 census omissions and doc corrections hold; twelve former Fast-follow items done except newQueueProcesses.

Awareness framing filter: control frames, fragmentation, masking alignment, extended lengths, no permessage-deflate; Hijack resets both gorilla read paths; every provider message is named, so the nameless-message rule closes no legitimate socket.
